verdicts.reason: A: the white logo band is broken. It is offset from the left and top and stops short of the right edge, and the logo inside is shrunk to a tiny mark. The headline runs almost to the canvas edges, the body copy is jammed right under it with no divider space, and the orange rule now sits on the top edge of the CTA. That leaves a cramped middle and an empty bottom third. B: it keeps the original structure: a full-width header, a logo at a sensible size, an even stack of kicker, headline, divider, body and CTA, and clear hierarchy. Its only small flaws are a slightly heavy empty area at the bottom and the headline wrapping close to the side margins.
